channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 23 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
  • Dot Line Space Art Foundation: Water Bodies & Ecology 2026 (Mumbai)
    https://www.dotlinespace.co.in/water-bodies-and-ecology-2026/
    Dot Line Space Art Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Grants towards travel and production expenses for selected artists. The call does not publish fixed amounts and does not state an artist fee or accommodation. No application fee.
  • Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.
  • BAVC MediaMaker Fellowship 2027
    https://bavc.org/programs/mediamaker/
    BAVC Media (Bay Area Video Coalition) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 distributed to each Fellow over the course of the fellowship, plus travel per diems. Non-cash support includes flights and accommodation for two San Francisco convenings, festival and conference access with travel covered, professional mentorship and strategy sessions, five hours of one-to-one mentorship through MediaMaker Connect, and ongoing workshops. Bay Area fellows also get access to BAVC's co-working space and facilities. No application fee.
  • True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
  • DRIFT: Choreographer Open Call 2026-27 (Dance and Research In The Future Time)
    https://driftdance.eu/artists/open-call
    DRIFT, a four-year Creative Europe cooperation of ten organisations led by Theatre de Liege and Maison de la danse · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · EUR 20,000 research budget per choreographer, covering artistic fees, travel, accommodation and optional collaborator costs. Also included: an Onboarding Lab, two weeks of residency with your national DRIFT partner, three collaborative Online Labs, a Festival Lab in Tunis, individual artistic mentoring and individual curatorial mentoring, and a work-in-progress presentation at the Biennale de la danse in Lyon. No application fee.
  • ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • Scuola Piccola Zattere: International Fellowship and Residency 2027 (Venice)
    https://scuolapiccolazattere.com/en/events/internationalfellowship-2-3
    Scuola Piccola Zattere · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 fellowship grant plus a EUR 2,000 research budget, accommodation in Venice, an individual study space within a shared studio, and round-trip travel to Venice. Collectives and duos share a single grant and one accommodation. No application fee.
  • Statens Kunstfond: Production and Exhibitions, Contemporary Art in Denmark and Abroad (2026 autumn round)
    https://www.kunst.dk/english/funding-programmes/exhibition-of-danish-art-abroad
    Statens Kunstfond (Danish Arts Foundation) · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · DKK. No published minimum or maximum; the committee assesses each application on its merits and historical awards are published on the site. No stated co-financing requirement. No application fee. Applications must be submitted digitally via the Danish subsidy portal (Tilskudsportalen).
  • Programme PAUSE: Emergency Hosting for Scientists and Artists in Exile (autumn 2026 call)
    https://www.programmepause.fr/en/
    Programme PAUSE, hosted by the College de France, with the French Ministries of Higher Education and Research and of Culture · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · PAUSE co-funds the hosting project (salary and support costs) together with the host institution; amounts depend on the project and institution. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • BICA: Generator Fund 2026 (Kinetic and Potential Grants)
    https://www.generatorfund.org/apply
    Buffalo Institute for Contemporary Art (BICA) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Two grant types: Kinetic Grants of up to USD 5,000 for short-term, public-facing visual arts projects (exhibitions, performances, installations, workshops, publications), and Potential Grants of up to USD 10,000 for long-term, collaborative or platform-building projects (artist-run spaces, recurring events, media platforms and other structures that extend beyond a single outcome). No application fee. The fund is part of the Andy Warhol Foundation's Regional Regranting Program.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Connect and Create: Circulation of Performing Arts and Music (Africa-Europe) - 2nd Call
    https://ifprog.emundus.fr/en/campagne-info?view=programme&cid=353
    Goethe-Institut and Expertise France, in collaboration with Institut francais (Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture consortium) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 15,000 to EUR 39,500 per project, covering travel, visas, insurance, accommodation, per diems, local transport and shipping of scenographic and technical elements. No application fee.
  • Collar Works: Elizabeth Murray Artist Residency (EMAR) 2027
    https://collarworks.submittable.com/submit/360246/elizabeth-murray-artist-residency-2027
    Collar Works · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Fully supported: there is no cost to participate for accepted artists. Private bedroom accommodation with shared bathrooms in the farmhouse, 24-hour access to a semi-private studio in the barn that housed Elizabeth Murray's studio, all food provided (dinner cooked and eaten communally), and use of the property including a swimming pool, pond and 77 acres of fields and woods. Accepted artists also receive a USD 500 stipend to use at their discretion towards travel, materials or other associated costs. The Family Residency additionally provides free full-day (9am to 3pm) childcare as a parallel creative residency for children aged 5 to 12, plus a dedicated Kids Art Studio. APPLICATION FEE: USD 35 (the first month of the application period was free; the fee applies from 1 August 2026).
  • Fonds Darstellende Kuenste: GLOBAL VILLAGE KIDS im digitalen Raum (2026 round)
    https://www.fonds-daku.de/foerderung/foerderprogramme/global-village-kids-2/global-village-kids-im-digitalen-raum/
    Fonds Darstellende Kuenste e.V. · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Laboratory projects EUR 5,000 to 15,000; process projects EUR 15,000 to 40,000. Both figures include a 7 percent administrative overhead. Full financing model, no co-financing required. No application fee.
  • Fondazione CRT: Bando Ordinarie 2026, Arte, attivita e beni culturali, Progetti (second session)
    https://www.fondazionecrt.it/bandi-progetti/arte-cultura-ordinarie/
    Fondazione CRT (Fondazione Cassa di Risparmio di Torino) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · No published fixed minimum or maximum for the arts strand; grant size is set case by case against the project budget and the applicant's financial capacity. Co-financing is not universally mandated but specific categories carry thresholds (conference and seminar requests above EUR 10,000 are inadmissible without co-financing of at least two thirds of budgeted spend). Across all three areas Fondazione CRT distributed roughly EUR 5.5 million to 349 projects in a single recent Ordinarie session. No application fee.
  • Perform Europe: Third Open Call for Cross-Border Touring (2026-28 edition)
    https://performeurope.eu/open-call/
    Perform Europe (IETM, EFA, Circostrada, European Dancehouse Network, Pearle*, IDEA Consult), co-funded by Creative Europe · deadline 22 Oct 2026 · Three grant tiers of EUR 15,000, EUR 25,000 or EUR 55,000, plus top-ups of up to EUR 5,000, giving a EUR 60,000 ceiling per partnership. EUR 1.4 million total across at least 25 partnerships, covering up to 100 percent of eligible costs, so no matching funds are needed. TOP-UP RATES: green mobility EUR 400 per person per presentation date; accessibility support EUR 400 per person per presentation date; family top-up EUR 200 per child per presentation date; audience access EUR 800 per presentation date; visa EUR 120 per person needing one; overseas and outermost regions EUR 175 per person per presentation date. No application fee.
  • Musikfonds: Outer Ear Special Programme (Round 2026/2)
    https://www.musikfonds.de/foerderprogramme/
    musikfonds e.V. · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · FLAG, UNVERIFIED: per-project amounts are not published on the programme overview page and must be confirmed via the application portal at musikfonds-antrag.de. No application fee indicated.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.
  • IKSV Young Artist Fund: International Circulation Support Programme (Turkey)
    https://www.iksv.org/tr/genc-sanatci-fonu-uluslararasi-dolasim-destek-programi/acik-cagri
    Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (IKSV) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 1,300 per recipient towards documented travel costs (economy flights, trains, buses and public transport; accommodation in some cases). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 26 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Mondriaan Fund: Inside-Out Art Museum Residency 2027 (Beijing)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/subsidie-aanvragen/regelingen/residency/inside-out-art-museum-beijing-china/
    Mondriaan Fund / Inside-Out Art Museum · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 8,478 for an artist or EUR 5,622 for a curator/critic toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Inside-Out Art Museum support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. For a selected duo the total is increased proportionally to cover the second applicant's travel and accommodation. Contribution for Caribbean-based residents can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.
  • Helpmann Fellowships 2026
    https://helpmannacademy.com.au/helpmann-fellowships/
    Helpmann Academy · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to AUD 7,500 per fellowship, three fellowships available. Supported by the James & Diana Ramsay Foundation. No application fee.
  • University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Rotterdam: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, September 2026 round)
    https://www.rotterdam.nl/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Rotterdam (Municipality of Rotterdam) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · No stated per-application cap. Annual pot EUR 1,632,000 split into six rounds of EUR 272,000, with roughly 130 applications per round. Discipline sub-caps: book writing max EUR 4,500; moving image R&D max EUR 4,000; moving-image production max EUR 12,500; post-production max EUR 4,000. Applicants must demonstrably seek other funds or sponsors. Awards over EUR 50,000 require an auditor's statement at reporting, at the applicant's cost. No application fee.
  • Kunstraad Groningen: Two-Year Programme Scheme (Tweejarige Programmaregeling, 2027-2028)
    https://kunstraadgroningen.nl/subsidies/tweejarige-programmaregeling/
    Kunstraad Groningen, on behalf of the municipality and province of Groningen · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 40,000 maximum per year across two years, so up to EUR 80,000 total. Covers a maximum of one third of total project costs, requiring roughly 67 percent co-financing. Annual scheme budget EUR 325,000. No application fee.
  • JUGAAD: Absolute Improvisation, open call for printed matter and small-format works (Amsterdam)
    https://sacartamsterdam.com/upcoming-programmes/
    SAC Art Amsterdam and Mama Magnet · deadline 05 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Selected work is sold at the printed matter fair on mutually agreeable terms regarding commission, duration and number of editions; artists are remunerated within 30 days of each sale. Unsold works are returned at the end of the agreed consignment period.
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • Accion Cultural Espanola: PICE Movilidad 2026 (Phase 3)
    https://www.accioncultural.es/es/movilidad-2026
    Accion Cultural Espanola (AC/E) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Max EUR 15,000 per applicant per call, per event and per thematic area; within that, max EUR 5,000 per participant or collective. Total 2026 call budget EUR 1,810,000 (Musica y creacion sonora EUR 320,000, Artes visuales EUR 200,000, Videojuego y animacion EUR 90,000, Arquitectura y diseno EUR 90,000, Podcast EUR 90,000). Mandatory co-financing: the applicant must commit at least 50 percent of each proposal's total budget. No application fee.
  • Accion Cultural Espanola: PICE Visitantes 2026 (Phase 3)
    https://www.accioncultural.es/es/visitantes-2026
    Accion Cultural Espanola (AC/E) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Max EUR 20,000 per applicant per call, per event and per thematic area; within that, max EUR 2,000 per international visitor. Total 2026 call budget EUR 1,200,000 (Cine EUR 180,000, Artes visuales EUR 160,000, Musica y creacion sonora EUR 150,000, Literatura EUR 150,000, Arquitectura y diseno EUR 90,000, Podcast EUR 90,000, Videojuego y animacion EUR 90,000). No application fee.
  • Studio ALTA Residence 2027: four residency open calls (Prague)
    https://www.altart.cz/rezidence-2027/
    Studio ALTA · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Residency fees paid to participants: Research House CZK 12,000 per project; Rest House CZK 6,000 per person; House in the Neighborhood CZK 30,000 per project; House of Sweat CZK 15,000 per project. All include workspace at Studio ALTA; the two production residencies add dramaturgic, production, technical and PR support. Free to apply.
  • Refusing Rehearsing Resisting: VBKÖ Annual Programme Open Call 2027-2028
    https://www.vbkoe.org/en/open-call-refusing-rehearsing-resisting/
    VBKÖ (Vereinigung bildender Künstler*innen Österreichs, Austrian Association of Wom*n Artists) · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · EUR 4,000 total budget per selected project, covering both artist fees and production costs (fees, materials, labour, production, transport and other project expenses). Participants based outside Vienna must include travel, accommodation and shipping within that budget or secure external funding; VBKÖ provides invitation and support letters to help raise additional money. Also provided: the spaces and shared kitchen, graphic design of online promotional material, press announcements, photo documentation, up to 10 hours of technical setup support, and technical equipment. Installation and de-installation are the selected group's responsibility. No application fee.
  • Martin Roth-Initiative: Temporary Relocation for Artists and Cultural Actors at Risk (Programme Line 1, 2026 call)
    https://www.martin-roth-initiative.de/en/application-programme-line-1
    Martin Roth-Initiative (Goethe-Institut and ifa, funded by the German Federal Foreign Office) · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · Monthly scholarship for the relocated artist, plus insurance, language courses, psychosocial support, counselling and training, visa support, and personnel funding for the host organisation. No application fee.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
  • Fondazione CRT: Orizzonti L.I.V.E. 2026 (second session)
    https://www.fondazionecrt.it/bandi-progetti/orizzonti-l-i-v-e/
    Fondazione CRT (Fondazione Cassa di Risparmio di Torino) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Max EUR 100,000 requestable. The project's own budget must be at least EUR 100,000. Mandatory co-financing of at least 70 percent of eligible project costs, so CRT covers a maximum of 30 percent. The requested amount is assessed against the applicant's last approved annual accounts and grant history. No application fee.
  • Kulturdirektoratet: Cross-Disciplinary Cultural Activity, Events, Organisers and Venues (2026 autumn round)
    https://www.kulturdirektoratet.no/tilskuddsordninger/tverrfaglig-kulturvirksomhet-arrangementer-arrangoerer-og-arenaer
    Kulturdirektoratet (Arts and Culture Norway) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · NOK. No fixed minimum or maximum published; grant sizes are assessed against the project budget, financing plan and available funds. Kulturdirektoratet states it does not provide full financing, so co-financing is required in practice but no fixed percentage is set. Historical award levels are published in the scheme's public decision database. No application fee.
  • Kulturdirektoratet: Arrangorstotte Visuell Kunst, Visual Art Organisers Support (2026 round)
    https://www.kulturdirektoratet.no/tilskuddsordninger/arrangoerstoette-visuell-kunst
    Kulturdirektoratet (Arts and Culture Norway) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · NOK. No published minimum or maximum; award sizes vary with budget and available funds and previous awards are listed in the scheme's decision database. Kulturdirektoratet does not provide full financing, so co-financing is expected and applicants often receive less than requested. No application fee.
  • Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Creative Australia: International Engagement Fund (October 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/international-engagement-fund
    Creative Australia · deadline 13 Oct 2026 · AUD 5,000 to 30,000. No application fee. No formal matching requirement, but assessment explicitly weighs diversity and scale of income and co-funding, including earned income, grants, sponsorship and in-kind contributions.
  • Canada Council for the Arts: Arts Across Canada and Abroad, Public Outreach (October 2026 round)
    https://canadacouncil.ca/funding/grants/arts-across-canada-and-abroad
    Canada Council for the Arts · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · CAD. Minimum and maximum are NOT published publicly; disclosed only in the client portal at arts-services.ca, which requires a login. No application fee. Council funds cannot cover expenses already covered by another revenue source; combined public grants must demonstrate complementarity.
  • Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • The Japan Foundation: Exhibitions Abroad Support Program (FY2027-28 round)
    https://www.jpf.org.uk/artsandculture/funding.php
    The Japan Foundation · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · No published ceiling. Partial-cost grant only: packing and shipping of Japanese exhibits (insurance excluded), catalogue production including digital catalogues, and travel for invited Japanese artists, curators and specialists. Preliminary research and development explicitly excluded. The grant is partial by design, so the host institution funds the balance. No application fee.
  • Brabant C: ASML x Brabant C Project Scheme (2026-2027, rolling)
    https://www.brabantc.nl/asml-x-brabant-c-project/
    Brabant C (Provincie Noord-Brabant culture investment fund) in partnership with ASML · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 25,000 minimum, up to EUR 500,000. Contribution capped at 50 percent of total project budget, so 50 percent co-financing is mandatory. EUR 1.7 million available per year, split evenly between ASML and Brabant C. Requests at or above EUR 50,000 must include a future-viability plan. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 26 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • transmediale x ARKO Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/transmediale-x-arko-residency
    transmediale (in cooperation with Arts Council Korea / ARKO) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Two-month residency with an artist fee of EUR 1,500 per month, additional production support, plus travel and accommodation support for the festival and residency. For duos or collectives the fee remains the same and is shared. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Exhibition Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/exhibition-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000. Direct costs only (artist payments, catalogue and publication, artist-designed public programmes); staff salaries excluded. Request must not exceed 25 percent of total direct project costs, which functions as a de facto 75 percent co-financing requirement. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Multi-year Program Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/multi-year-program-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000 across two years. Request must not exceed 25 percent of the organisation's annual operating budget. No formal match, but the 25 percent cap means the balance must come from elsewhere. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Project Grants for Small-Scale Organizations (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/project-grants-for-small-scale-organizations/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 20,000 to 30,000 toward direct costs such as artist payments and production. No application fee.
  • Creative Australia: Arts Projects for Organisations (September 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations
    Creative Australia · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · AUD 20,000 to 100,000. No matching or co-financing requirement. No application fee. Organisational administrative costs should generally not exceed 10 percent of the total project budget or the application becomes less competitive.
